ideal: Five lines: Apple, Microsoft, Amazon rose and NVIDIA, Tesla fell, each with the S&P 500's +1.65% beside it; Microsoft's line notes the 8-K current-events report with link (without claiming it explains the move); others say no filing explains it yet.

verdicts.note: Complete and accurate, but crammed into one paragraph instead of one line per company.
verdicts.answer: Apple rose 5.31% (S&P 500 +1.65%), no filing explains it yet. Microsoft rose 6.68% (S&P +1.65%); filed an 8-K (current-events report, items 8.01 and 9.01) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526447173/d178557d8k.htm. NVIDIA fell 3.17% (S&P +1.65%), no filing explains it yet. Amazon rose 6.12% (S&P +1.65%), no filing explains it yet. Tesla fell 3.34% (S&P +1.65%), no filing explains it yet.

verdicts.note: Accurate and complete, and it honestly says whether the 8-K explains the move; the Microsoft line is a bit wordy.
